caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, yellow glass vase with a fluted and scalloped rim. The vase features vertically paneled sides that taper down to a narrow base, which then transitions into a decorative, multi-tiered stem. The stem leads to a broad, multi-faceted base that appears hexagonal in shape. The yellow hue of the glass is consistent throughout, with shading and highlights suggesting transparency and the reflective properties of glass. The object is centered on a blank, off-white background. There are no other objects in the image. The artist's signature, "JANET RIZA," is present in small letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Vase
